description: Tool contracts for the Infeara revenue team's autonomous loops. A tool is usable only when its status is 'live'. Everything else must run from exports, or be marked as a mock output.

status_definitions.live: MCP connected and authenticated; the team may call it without asking.
status_definitions.staged: MCP being built. The team consumes manual exports only, and marks outputs 'provisional'.
status_definitions.planned: No tool. The team works from the knowledge base and manual input.

tools.name: Google Search Console
capabilities: search-analytics.query: dimensions query|page|country|device, 16 months of history
url-inspection.inspect: index status, canonical, crawl result for one URL
sites.list: verified properties and their permission level
tools.cadence: daily pull, weekly analysis, monthly report
tools.failure_mode: If the MCP is unavailable, request a CSV export of Search Analytics and continue; mark the analysis 'export-based'.

tools.name: Infeara CRM
expected_capabilities: leads.list / leads.get: new and unworked leads
deals.list / deals.update: stage, amount, close date
tools.expected_auth: service account with scoped write access to leads and activities

fallback_until_live.output: analysis + suggested actions written to integrations/outbox/, never written back to the CRM
fallback_until_live.label: Every output must carry 'provisional — CRM not connected'

data_rules: Do not copy lead PII into knowledge/ or into any outbound content.
Do not store lead PII in the repo; work from the inbox file and delete after the run.
Reason codes and statuses are the only fields written back without human review.

tools.name: Infeara Website CMS
expected_capabilities: pages.list / pages.get: existing pages, slugs, metadata
pages.create / pages.update: draft-first, with publish flag
sitemap.ping: notify search engines after publish
schemas.get: page templates and required fields
tools.expected_auth: editor token that can create drafts but not publish without approval

fallback_until_live.input: manual page inventory at integrations/inbox/cms-inventory.csv (url, title, target_keyword, status, last_updated)
fallback_until_live.output: Markdown drafts in integrations/outbox/content/ with frontmatter (slug, title, meta_description, schema, internal_links)
fallback_until_live.publish: human copies into the CMS; the team never claims a page is live
fallback_until_live.label: Every output must carry 'draft — CMS not connected'

tools.publish_rule: No skill publishes to the website. Drafts only, until a human approves.

knowledge_base.rule: Only source of company facts. No fact outside these files.
